findings.finding: Cortical experiments demonstrate distinct transient LTP and LTD eligibility traces converted by specific monoaminergic receptors; a single scalar history trace is therefore not biologically distinctive.
A 2026 Physiological Reviews synthesis treats eligibility traces/synaptic tags as temporary synapse-specific memories acted on by later neuromodulation across striatum, hippocampus and cortex.
sources: Long-term potentiation in the brain: a synaptic memory mechanism, Physiological Reviews 2026, DOI 10.1152/physrev.00028.2025
